requires.name: node
requires.guide: Node.js runs the project. Download the LTS version from nodejs.org, run the installer, then open a new terminal window and check that 'node --version' prints a number.
requires.reason: It runs the to-do program and its checks.

requires.name: git
requires.guide: Git keeps the saved versions of the project. Download it from git-scm.com, run the installer with the default choices, then open a new terminal window and check that 'git --version' prints a number.
requires.reason: It keeps a saved version of the work at every step.

humanSteps: Set your name and email for saved versions, once, when asked.
